docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The dialogue of Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna on the field of Kurukṣetra, in its eighteen chapters, in the Sanskrit text of the Bhīṣmaparvan of the Mahābhārata (chapters 25 to 42 of the vulgate, in which the verses are numbered 6-25-1 and so on).

From Wikisource · Public domain

The Sanskrit text of the Mahābhārata, Bhīṣmaparvan 25–42, as transcribed on Sanskrit Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
